"""Main executes one qualified arm after fresh exact-environment health."""
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v5'
Q = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-admission-root-v2/qualification.json'
Q_SHA = '3cb570f5e7383e747ce009872220200cf5e69901f106f891e284fed5db34cf99'
STARTUP = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v5/xe-startup/record.json'
STARTUP_SHA = '10b2b49fa51ff8e260cb88eb82c33d92dd6c10b059492384fc7b5e6d46c1d15d'
HEALTH = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-v1.py'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--phase', required=True, choices=['debug-off', 'debug-on',
        'timed1-off', 'timed1-on', 'timed2-on', 'timed2-off', 'timed3-off',
        'timed3-on', 'heldout-off', 'heldout-on'])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert sha(Q) == Q_SHA and sha(STARTUP) == STARTUP_SHA
    startup = json.loads(STARTUP.read_text())
    assert startup['passed'] and startup['complete'] and not startup['active']
    assert startup['qualification_sha256'] == Q_SHA and startup['kernel_gate_passed']
    assert startup['model_close']['normal'] and not startup['model_close']['forced']
    for key in ['startup_diagnostics', 'startup_protocol_diagnostics',
                'post_ready_diagnostics', 'final_diagnostics', 'protocol_diagnostics']:
        assert not startup[key]['severe_messages'] and not startup[key]['compile_messages']
    assert len(startup['selected_device_stderr_lines']) == 1
    review = dict(passed=True, active=False, complete=True, main_reviewed=True,
        predecessor_sha256=STARTUP_SHA, predecessor_path=str(STARTUP),
        compile_diagnostics_reviewed=True, provider_identity_reviewed=True,
        scope='Actual native-provider startup PASS and mapped-library identity; model comparison remains separate',
        reviewed_by='/root')
    review_path = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-startup-review-v1.json'
    with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        if review_path.exists():
            assert json.loads(review_path.read_text()) == review
        else:
            review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, indent=2) + '\n')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('main_phase_fresh_health', HEALTH)
    health = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(health)
    sys.argv = [str(HEALTH), '--engine', 'xe', '--phase', args.phase, '--serial', '1']
    assert health.main() == 0, 'Fresh native integer health failed; no model launch'
    health_root = B / ('latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-xe-' + args.phase + '-root-v1')
    receipt = health_root / 'record.json'
    wrapper = health_root / 'model-admission-health.json'
    assert not wrapper.exists()
    fresh = json.loads(receipt.read_text())
    assert fresh['passed'] and fresh['complete'] and not fresh['active']
    fresh['original_fresh_health_receipt'] = pin(receipt)
    fresh['startup_review'] = pin(review_path)
    fresh['main_wrapper_source'] = pin(Path(__file__))
    wrapper.write_text(json.dumps(fresh, indent=2) + '\n')
    sys.path.insert(0, str(P))
    sys.argv = [str(P / 'run_root.py'), '--engine', 'xe', '--phase', args.phase,
        '--qualification', str(Q), '--qualification-sha256', Q_SHA,
        '--fresh-health', str(wrapper), '--fresh-health-sha256', sha(wrapper)]
    runpy.run_path(str(P / 'run_root.py'), run_name='__main__')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
